summary: End-to-end verification of the new Music Zone feature (Spotify-styled dark island). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass on /api/music/* (list, upload, non-audio reject, >50MB reject, stream with bearer + ?auth= query, 401 without auth, like toggle + /liked, history log + /history/me, non-owner delete 403, owner delete + track removed). Frontend: Music Zone loads at /music with dark theme, sidebar (Home/Liked/Recent/Uploads), green hero 'All Team Tracks', empty state, and Upload track CTA. Upload modal opens via open-upload-btn, accepts file via set_input_files, submits, and the uploaded track appears in list. Clicking a row starts playback: sticky bottom player (data-testid=music-player) shows with player-title, and all controls present (toggle/next/prev/mute/volume/seek/close). Player persists across navigation (verified visible on / home page after leaving /music). Search filter works. Like toggles green heart and 'Liked Songs' view surfaces the track. Delete button visible for owner (alex) but NOT visible for non-owner (jamie) — cross-user check confirmed. Deleting removes the row and clears the player queue automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend stream endpoint accepts token via both Authorization header and ?auth= query param (needed by <audio> element) — decoded with pyjwt using JWT_SECRET; returns 401 on missing/invalid, 404 on missing song, 500 on storage fetch failure. Clean.
Object storage init is lazy + cached with force-refresh on 404 in _put/_get — resilient to storage key rotation.
songs collection uses is_deleted soft-delete; list_tracks correctly filters. song_likes stored separately and joined via $in.
server.py is now ~1911 lines — approaching the 700-line file-size threshold in the code-review guidelines. Recommend splitting music routes into /app/backend/routes/music.py in a follow-up refactor.
Non-owner delete correctly returns 403; admin bypass via user.role == 'admin' works.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ / UI_TEST_ / OWNER_TEST_ songs uploaded and cleaned up during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Music Zone backend + frontend fully verified in iteration 8. All 11 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_music.py pass. UI flows (upload, play, persist, search, like, owner-only delete, non-owner hidden delete, player close via delete) verified via Playwright. No open bugs. Only forward-looking recommendation: consider splitting server.py (1911 lines) into per-feature route modules.
